name: ai-workflow-ranking
description: Rank recurring workflows and decide which one to automate with AI first. Produces a ranked build-first plan, readiness gates, a connected system sketch, and a static HTML report.

interface.shortDescription: Decide which workflow to automate first
interface.longDescription: A guided diagnostic for ranking recurring workflows, identifying readiness gaps, choosing the best first AI automation proof, and packaging the result as a clean static HTML report.
defaultPrompt: Use AI Workflow Ranking to pick my first automation workflow. If I only give a company name or business type, infer a draft workflow set, inputs, outputs, and assumptions, then rank it without stopping for more detail.
